caseName: Plante v. Scott ex rel. Weintraub
caseNameFull: Plante, Commissioner of Institutions and Agencies of New Jersey v. Scott, by and through his Guardian, Weintraub

opinions.text: C. A. 3d Cir. Motion of American Psychiatric Association for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Youngberg v. Romeo, 457 U. S. 307 (1982).
